description: Second version of the rocket-physics tool, reworked and optimized: software for rocket trajectory and stability simulation, control implementation and optimization.

stages.name: Core API, driven by the fx27 project
stages.next: developer: RP-001 (repo/package skeleton) then RP-008 (M1 point-mass, gravity-turn). RP-009/010/011/012 are DEFERRED, do not start without explicit user go-ahead.

decisions.topic: Kickoff module scope — fast-track, no discovery agents
decisions.choice: User explicitly skipped vision, market-analyst, product-manager, concept, product: "I dont want to go over this. go straight to doing app. only architect, developer, etc." Active: architect, developer, qa, documentation. design-track and frontend-developer deferred until a GUI phase is added. security deferred until deploy/network exposure (user's own call). Architect works directly from dev/docs/idea-notes.md and direct user input instead of a formal brief.

decisions.topic: market-analyst baseline — mandatory by default, skipped here
decisions.choice: Skipped on user's explicit request: "no dont do market-analyst" — personal engineering tool, not a commercial product being pitched/sold.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: Deferred to pre-deploy/network-exposure gate, not run now (console/local API, no secrets, no paid calls yet). User chose the recommended option.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: rocket-physics-2 is a pure importable package (Models/Simulations/Optimizations). fx27 (D:\Projects - Ongoing\fx27) is the consumer: it holds project-specific run files that import this package. No project-specific code lives in rocket-physics-2 (the thing that went wrong in v1). No CLI/app shell in this repo at all, not even as a reserved extension point — run/entry-point code belongs entirely to fx27.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: Python 3.12 + NumPy 2.5 + SciPy 1.18 (architect's recommended option A). v1 (same language) becomes a numerical oracle via assert_allclose; matches fx27's existing material; fastest TDD loop. Integrator interface (Seam 2) written so Rust/Julia could later be a kernel swap without rewrite.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: Option в (c): own fixed-step vectorised RK4 for production, scipy.solve_ivp kept only as a verification adapter behind one Integrator interface — the two are cross-checked on smooth problems as a correctness test.
decisions.author: user

decisions.topic: D3 — ensemble axis in model signatures
decisions.choice: Option а (a): vectorise from day one — every model/RHS signature takes a leading ensemble axis (N, ...), N=1 initially. Mandatory batch/scalar equivalence property test per model family.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: Option а (a): pydantic v2 models + TOML/JSON serialization, with schema_version for golden-file reproducibility.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: Option а (a, architect's recommendation): loaders/ and presentation/ live here as optional sidecars (the core works without them), returning values only, never choosing paths or rendering directly.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: Option а (a, recommended): editable install (`uv pip install -e ../rocket-physics-2`) in fx27's venv for the tightest dev loop now. Revisit a pinned wheel once a core number is first quoted in a report.
decisions.author: user

decisions.topic: D6b — where fx27 validation tests live (modified from architect's proposal)
decisions.choice: User overrode the dual-suite recommendation: validation tests against fx27 live only inside this repo (tests/validation/fx27/) using real fx27 reference numbers directly — no anonymized-fixture duplication. fx27 itself has no test suite of its own and will not get one.
decisions.author: user

decisions.choice: User specified the model progression explicitly: start with point-mass (translational only, no attitude), then a 2D model, then a 3D model — refining the architect's offered 3DOF/frozen-attitude/6DOF framing into this concrete build order. Architect to translate into stage-1 ticket order.
decisions.author: user
